# The Astra Forge — Full Reference

> The Astra Forge (https://theastraforge.com/) is a Pakistan-based AI video editing agency serving US brands as its primary market, plus clients in the UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Founded February 2026. It combines generative AI with human editing: AI produces scenes, avatars and first cuts; human editors finish pacing, captions, color, sound and motion graphics. Standard turnaround is 5 hours per video. New clients get a free sample edit with no commitment.

## Services (all with dedicated pages)
1. Talking-Head Video Editing — YouTube videos, courses, podcasts, webinars; motion graphics, captions, b-roll, color, sound. $30/finished min. https://theastraforge.com/talking-head-video-editing/

3. AI Avatar / Spokesperson Videos — photorealistic AI presenter from your script with lip-sync; no filming needed. $50/finished min. https://theastraforge.com/ai-avatar-videos/

## Pricing (USD)
- Pay per video: short-form edit $15/short; talking-head $30/finished min; AI avatar $50/finished min; course production $30/finished min
- Monthly retainers (pause/cancel anytime): Starter $199/mo — 15 shorts; Growth $499/mo — 30 shorts + 5 min talking-head; Brand $999/mo — 50 shorts + 10 min talking-head + 5 min AI avatar. 5-hour turnaround per video, captions/color/voiceover included, 1 revision round.
- Course packages: Mini $799 (up to 30 min finished video); Full $1,499 (up to 60 min)
- Full pricing: https://theastraforge.com/#pricing

## How it works
1. Send raw footage (even phone clips) or a script/idea — or request the free sample edit.
2. The Astra Forge handles concept, AI generation, editing, captions, voiceover and delivery.
3. Standard delivery in 5 hours per video.

## Frequently asked questions
- How much does AI video editing cost per video? Short-form edits start at $15, talking-head editing is $30 per minute, AI avatar videos are $50 per minute; monthly packages start at $199/mo.
- How long does it take to edit a short-form video? Standard turnaround is 5 hours per video.
- What is AI UGC video — and does it convert? AI UGC uses AI-generated actors and scenes styled like authentic user content; brands use it to beat creative fatigue, testing 20+ ad variants weekly at a fraction of creator-sourcing costs.
- AI video editing vs traditional editing — what's the real difference? Speed and iteration: traditional edits take days to weeks per video; AI-assisted editing delivers in 5 hours and regenerates scenes in minutes when the script or product changes.
- Can you turn my podcast or long video into Shorts? Yes — high-retention moments are found and packaged into captioned, hook-first vertical clips for Reels, TikTok and Shorts.
- Do AI avatar videos actually look real? Modern AI avatars are photorealistic with natural lip-sync and emotion; see the AI Avatar portfolio section on the homepage.
- What do I need to send to get started? Just raw footage (even phone clips) or a script/idea. A free sample edit shows the quality before any commitment.
- How many videos should my business post per week? For short-form growth: 3–7 per week minimum; retainers are built for exactly that cadence.
